label: Google Drive: Upload
description: Put a stored file into Drive, optionally inside a folder and under a new name. Emits the Drive file id and a view link.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account. The files-you-pick grant covers files this project creates.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: The Drive filename. Defaults to the stored file's name.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder id
inputs.description: The destination Drive folder's id (from its URL). Empty = My Drive root.
